title: UMCR: Universal Medical Concept Recognition through Guideline Integration and Agentic Linking
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向
missingSignals: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Medical Concept Recognition is the task of extracting and grounding spans in medical text to entries in a standard ontology.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Our method also reduces dependence on parametric LLM memory, thanks to improved interaction with the target ontology compared to other proposed approaches.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: More recent approaches like REAL and AutoPCR make direct use of Large Language Models and can theoretically adapt to any ontology choice but suffer from a lack of generalization.
